title: PBA: Player of the Week Bolick determined to lead NLEX to deep playoff run
summary: Robert Bolick is determined to lead NLEX to a deep run in the 2026 PBA Governors' Cup playoffs, as he wants the Road Warriors to shed their tag as perennial underperformers.
